dataset_accounting.why_40292_vs_47296: Of the 47,296 shared-drug (cell_line, drug) pairs in GDSC2 (across 509 GDSC2 cell lines and 118 shared drugs), each of the 10 CTRPv2 LCO training splits trains on 90% of CTRPv2 cell lines (~510 lines). To prevent cell-line train->test leakage during cross-study evaluation, the 352..386 overlapping cell lines present in that split's 90% CTRPv2 training fold are excluded from GDSC2 evaluation on that split, leaving 427..436 GDSC2 test cell lines (375 disjoint GDSC2-only cell lines + 52..61 overlapping cell lines from the held-out 10% CTRPv2 LCO test fold) and 39,377..40,730 evaluated rows per split (mean 40,292.4 +- 389.4).
